scope: Continue Watching completed-copy priority and saved-provider resume; source/host verified, device pending
evidence_input: Owner report and screenshot showing Elementum buffering after tapping a reported completed movie; no reproduction log used. Raw screenshot/history/account state not published. Owner subsequently confirmed the completed copy is playable in Google Drive / Library, matching the missing Drive-check path.
verified_source_defects: A newly constructed downloaded player received a plain tmdb dict; pinned TMDb Helper resolver requires item.details.
Completed-copy lookup covered only local paths although automatic Drive upload can delete the local file.
Removing empty settings slots could classify active files as completed; mixed completed/partial versions could miss the finished copy.
Choosing a completed local file overwrote the saved provider and version origin.
Failed download checks and unavailable saved providers could fall through to another source choice.

Positive-sized matching file in an active torrent only when Elementum reports 100% complete
